trigger: 4th Street motel: a young deserter hiding in Room 9.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Nose at the crack of a motel door. Tail wagging. Not a warning.]

nodes.speaker: amb_pvt_marsh
nodes.text: Don't— Please. I'm not armed. I left it. I left it in the river.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A soldier, nineteen at most, in a motel bedspread. Ironwood patch torn off his sleeve. Shaking.

nodes.speaker: amb_pvt_marsh
nodes.text: Danny Marsh. Private. They told us to clear a house on Wells. There were kids in the house. I just walked.

nodes.speaker: amb_pvt_marsh
nodes.text: Thank you. Thank you. I'll— I don't know what I'll do. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He doesn't fight. He just nods, like he expected it. The MPs are not gentle.

nodes.speaker: amb_pvt_marsh
nodes.text: East. Okay. The farmers. They'll shoot me. ...Better them than us.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Outside, the loudspeaker again. Curfew in thirty minutes.
